strongest_verified_result: Given the stated deterministic additive-eccentricity oracle on finite median graphs, the threshold reduction and implicit search correctly return an exact center, optimum radius, and all centers in O(n log^5(2n)) exact operations.
exact_assumptions: Finite, nonempty, connected, simple, unit-edge median graph supplied by adjacency lists; medianity is promised.
Every profile value is a finite nonnegative real with exact comparison of bounded integer multiples.
Imported oracle returns every max_u(d_G(x,u)+a(u)) for integer a(u) in [0,n-1], deterministically in O(n log^4(2n)), including its preprocessing and requiring no supplied embedding or decomposition.
Standard graph/RAM index arithmetic on O(log n)-bit words; arbitrary-real operation counts are distinct from rational bit costs.
verified_components: Full feasible-set equality for multiplicative-to-additive threshold transform.
Zero weights, clamping, exact ties, n=1, all-zero profiles, singleton support and zero optimum.
Implicit n-sorted-row optimum candidate set, feasible incumbent and optimum-survival invariant.
Every weighted midpoint median removes at least one quarter of active multiplicity on either outcome, including singleton and repeated-entry rows.
Saved witnesses and final complete center set.
O(log(2n)) oracle calls and O(n log^2(2n)) original-weight comparison overhead.
Median-graph adjacency read bound via hypercube subset edge inequality.
Exact rational comparison operands have O(B+log n) bits; no encoding-independent bit bound claimed.
Complete author JSON reproduced byte-for-byte from scratch and both frozen seals verified.
remaining_gaps: This family's assignment does not independently certify the complete BDH imported theorem proof or its applicability; combine with the separate independent oracle audit before endorsing the unconditional headline.
Historical novelty and publication-package acceptance are not decided here.
